description: This file implements the PlayerInfo functionality, including codec information, resolution, audio modes, Atmos support, and event handling for a media platform. It defines the PlayerInfoImplementation class with methods for retrieving codecs, resolution, and audio settings, and manages event handlers and observer notifications.

classes.name: PlayerInfoImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing media player properties and Dolby output interface, managing codecs, resolution, audio modes, Atmos support, and event notifications.

classes.name: GstUtils
classes.description: Utility class for GStreamer operations, checking media types and registry elements.

methods.name: PlayerInfoImplementation
methods.description: Constructor initializing GStreamer, codecs, device manager, and event handlers.

methods.name: AudioCodecs
methods.description: Returns an iterator over supported audio codecs.

methods.name: VideoCodecs
methods.description: Returns an iterator over supported video codecs.

methods.name: IsAudioEquivalenceEnabled
methods.description: Checks if audio equivalence is enabled.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a Dolby output notification observer.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a Dolby output notification observer.

methods.name: AudioModeHandler
methods.description: Static callback for handling audio mode change events.

methods.name: audiomodeChanged
methods.description: Notifies observers of audio mode changes.

methods.name: AtmosMetadata
methods.description: Checks if Atmos metadata is supported.

methods.name: EnableAtmosOutput
methods.description: Enables or disables Atmos output mode.
